Hutan Pinus Mangunan: Another Dlingo Pine Spot

Hutan Pinus Mangunan is also listed by Kalurahan Terong as a Dlingo pine destination. This page helps understand its relation to Pinus Pengger and how to connect them.

Updated 28 October 2026

Detail

Position in the Dlingo belt

Mangunan is one of the pine destinations mentioned with Pinus Pengger and Becici in the Terong village documentation. This places it in the same Dlingo pine landscape.

Detail

Connecting with Pengger

  • Use a self-arranged vehicle.
  • Distance is approximate via hill roads.
  • Ask staff for the best route.

Detail

When to connect

Choose Mangunan to widen a pine route in one area; allow half a day or more.

Do not force many stops in one day; pick what fits best.

Frequently asked questions

Is Hutan Pinus Mangunan near Pengger?

Both are in the Dlingo pine belt; distance is approximate and needs confirmation.

Is it the same as Pinus Pengger?

No; they are different pine destinations in one Dlingo area.

What is the best route?

Ask staff for the Dlingo route linking them; use your own vehicle.

How much time is needed?

Varies by route; allow a buffer for hill roads.
